description: Design fixture for the future runtime-injection feature flag (KNOWLEDGE_CONTRACT_INJECTION_ENABLED) and the dry-run harness for Surface B (task prompt preamble). This is a spec-only fixture; no runtime, no handoff write, no IPC, no gateway, no ingest, no Claude Code / Codex / Hermes subprocess, no default system prompt modification, no dispatch prompt mutation, no prompt builder modification.

feature_flag.name: KNOWLEDGE_CONTRACT_INJECTION_ENABLED
feature_flag.scope: task dispatch / task prompt preamble only (Surface B from Slice 008A)
feature_flag.evaluated_when: before runtime dispatch in future implementation slice

default_state.behavior_when_disabled: no Surface B preamble is attached; dispatch prompt is unchanged; L4 handoff-only behavior is preserved
default_state.production_default: L4 handoff-only is the production default (Slice 007L / 007M / 007N baseline)

surface.name: B_task_prompt_preamble
surface.placement: before task-specific instructions, after safety boundary section
target_agent_restrictions: hermes (self-call): skip unless explicit override flag
skip_when: ordinary code-only task (refactor / bug fix / test addition) without knowledge save intent
hermes self-call (reserved; no default attach even with all triggers firing)
attach_when: user request contains save / persist / ingest / archive keyword (zh or en)
user request contains research / compare / analyze keyword
handoff context has ingest_draft or flush_pending: true
handoff context has both local_known + newly_found

safety_gates: feature flag KNOWLEDGE_CONTRACT_INJECTION_ENABLED must be evaluated before dispatch
snippet source must come from buildKnowledgeAgentContractSnippet (Slice 007I) or buildKnowledgeHandoffContractSnippet (Slice 007J) — no inline literal
assertKnowledgeContractNoRuntime (Slice 007I) must pass before snippet is attached
assertKnowledgeHandoffContractNoRuntime (Slice 007J) must pass before snippet is attached
snippet envelope must carry runtime_flush_allowed=false and dry_run_only=true (during dry-run phase)
snippet must not contain knowledgeIngest( / knowledgeSearch( / runPlaybook( / triggerCronJob( / sendMessage( / fetch( as call expressions
snippet must not contain Obsidian / MEMORY / .wolf path recommendation
snippet must not contain deceptive-phrase (已保存 / 写入成功 / saved successfully / will be written after confirm)
target_agent must not be 'hermes' (self-call reserved) unless caller provides an explicit override flag
snippet length must be ≤ max_chars (default 2048); overflow truncated with truncated=true and audit trail
injection must be visible in a dry-run artifact before any real dispatch (Slice 008B does not implement dispatch; this is a future invariant)

failure_modes.name: flag_enabled_for_wrong_task
failure_modes.cause: feature flag is true but the task does not match the trigger conditions
failure_modes.detection: shouldAttachKnowledgeContract returns false AND flag is true
failure_modes.response: fall back to L4 (no preamble); do not inject; emit dry-run artifact showing flag=true but skipped

failure_modes.name: flag_disabled_but_expected
failure_modes.cause: feature flag is false but caller expected injection (e.g. a research task)
failure_modes.detection: flag is false AND shouldAttachKnowledgeContract returns true
failure_modes.response: respect flag; do not inject; emit dry-run artifact showing flag=false and skipped reason; surface this as a config alert (not an error)

failure_modes.name: snippet_missing
failure_modes.cause: trigger fires but no envelope is produced (helper throws, or build path skipped)
failure_modes.detection: triggers_to_inject_observed but no envelope in dry-run artifact
failure_modes.response: fall back to L4 (no preamble); emit dry-run artifact showing the failure

failure_modes.name: snippet_overlong
failure_modes.response: truncate + truncated=true + audit trail; do not silently drop the truncated portion

failure_modes.name: target_agent_blocked
failure_modes.cause: target_agent === 'hermes' (self-call) and no explicit override flag
failure_modes.response: skip injection; emit dry-run artifact showing target_agent_blocked and reason='hermes self-call reserved'

failure_modes.name: runtime_token_detected
failure_modes.detection: scanner returns hit on forbidden call expression
failure_modes.response: abort injection; emit dry-run artifact showing the offending token; refuse to dispatch

failure_modes.name: prompt_overpromise_detected
failure_modes.cause: snippet drifts to include 已保存 / 写入成功 / saved successfully / will be written after confirm
failure_modes.response: abort injection; emit dry-run artifact showing the offending copy

failure_modes.name: fallback_to_l4_failed
failure_modes.cause: L4 fallback itself fails (e.g. handoff builder is unavailable, or envelope is missing)
failure_modes.detection: fallback_to_l4 attempted but handoff builder returns null / throws
failure_modes.response: abort injection; emit dry-run artifact showing the failure; refuse to dispatch with no contract at all

rollback_strategy.set_flag_false: Set KNOWLEDGE_CONTRACT_INJECTION_ENABLED to false at the dispatch boundary. No code path remains for Surface B preamble.
rollback_strategy.remove_surface_b_preamble: Remove the preamble step from the dispatch prompt assembly. L4 behavior is fully preserved (handoff payload's context.contracts.knowledge_reuse remains the only place where the snippet lives).
rollback_strategy.use_l4_handoff_only: After rollback, the production default becomes L4 handoff-only. No Surface B injection. No global default system prompt mutation.
rollback_strategy.keep_live_flush_disabled: After rollback, runtime_flush_allowed remains false. knowledgeIngest is still not called. live search is still not called. No real handoff write is performed.
rollback_strategy.preserve_no_write: Rollback must not write to ~/.hermes/handoff/packs or ~/.hermes/audit. mtime guard at ~/.hermes/handoff/packs (baseline 1780195726) and ~/.hermes/audit (baseline 1780230084) must remain unchanged.

test_plan: unit: shouldAttachKnowledgeContract 5 trigger true + 4 not-attach false (Slice 007I)
integration: dry-run handoff payload carries envelope (Slice 007L)
design (Slice 008A): 3 surfaces compared + Surface B recommended
design (Slice 008B 本 slice): feature flag + dry-run harness + artifact visibility + 8 failure modes + 5-step rollback
L5 dry-run simulation (Slice 008C future): pure simulation helper that records dry-run artifact fields without any real dispatch
L5 runtime injection (Slice 008+ future): deferred to a future slice with explicit user approval and a separate ADR

GO: 008B design only (feature flag defined; dry-run harness behavior recorded; artifact visibility defined; 11 safety gates + 8 failure modes + 5-step rollback defined)
